LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Corinthian.label: Corinthian helmet
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Corinthian.description: A bronze helmet beaten from a single sheet, with a nose guard, long cheek pieces and a horsehair crest. It hides the face completely.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Linothorax.label: linothorax
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Linothorax.description: Many layers of linen glued and stitched together into a stiff cuirass, with hanging strips to guard the hips. Light, cool and surprisingly tough.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Chiton.label: chiton
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Chiton.description: A light tunic pinned at the shoulders and belted at the waist. Comfortable in the heat and handsome in the agora.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Himation.label: himation
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Himation.description: A large wool mantle worn over the chiton, wrapped around the body and thrown over the shoulder. Philosophers wear nothing else.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_OliveWreath.label: olive wreath
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_OliveWreath.description: A wreath cut from the sacred olive tree, the only prize of the games. It is worth nothing and everyone wants it.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Evzone.label: evzone dress
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Evzone.description: A dark blue jacket embroidered in gold over the white pleated fustanella, with a red sash. The mountains' own uniform.
